adaptation_notes: The build fragment calls find_package(enkiTS CONFIG REQUIRED) and links enkiTS::enkiTS; its headers are included as <TaskScheduler.h>.

Setup glue owns the composition's one enki::TaskScheduler and the enki::TaskSchedulerConfig its bindings fill in: the allocation binding in the memory phase, the diagnostics binding in the diagnostics phase. The jobs binding initializes the scheduler with it when the jobs phase starts the jobs interface.
Game code that uses enkiTS directly calls am_enkits_scheduler(), never a scheduler of its own.
